entities.name: İlqar Mirzəyev
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ilgar Anzor oghlu Mirzayev was an Azerbaijani military officer, National Hero of Azerbaijan, and colonel serving in the Azerbaijani Armed Forces until his death during the July 2020 Armenian–Azerbaijani clashes. He also had participated in the April 2016 clashes.
